issues.desc: Checklist mostly describes internal mechanisms, but does not state one end-to-end user-recognizable completion scenario: a cross-provider CLI review remains observable past the caller boundary without duplicate restart, then exposes a definitive terminal/cancel result whose receipt is accepted by the review gate. Add this observable acceptance outcome to the planning/verification intent so the user can tell the feature is fully delivered.
